title: In-vitro and in-silico analysis and antitumor studies of novel Cu(II) and V(V) complexes of N-p-Tolylbenzohydroxamic acid.
authors: Tripathi, Mamta; Thakur, Yamini; Syed, Rabbani; Asatkar, Ashish Kumar; Alqahtani, Mohammad S; Das, Devashish; Agrawal, Rainy; Verma, Bharati; Pande, Rama
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过光谱、分子对接和MD模拟分析Cu(II)/V(V)配合物与DNA的沟槽结合，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Copper(L(2)Cu) and vanadium(L(2)VOCl) complexes of N-p-tolylbenzohydroxamic acid (LH) ligand have been investigated for DNA binding efficacy by multiple analytical, spectral, and computational techniques. The results revealed that complexes as groove binders as evidenced by UV absorption. Fluorescence studies including displacement assay using classical intercalator ethidium bromide as fluorescent probe also confirmed as groove binders. The viscometric analysis too supports the inferences as strong groove binders for both the complexes. Molecular docking too exposed DNA as a target to the complexes which precisely binds L(2)Cu, in the minor groove region while L(2)VOCl in major groove region. Molecular dynamic simulation performed on L(2)Cu complex revealing the interaction of complex with DNA within 20 ns time. The complex stacked into the nitrogen bases of oligonucleotides and the bonding features were intrinsically preserved for longer simulation times. In-vitro cytotoxicity study was undertaken employing MTT assay against the breast cancer cell line (MCF-7). Potential cytotoxic activities were observed for L(2)Cu and L(2)VOCl complexes with IC(50) values of showing 71 % and 74 % of inhibition respectively.
abstract_zh: N-对甲苯基苯甲羟肟酸（LH）配体的铜（L(2)Cu）和钒（L(2)VOCl）配合物已通过多种分析、光谱和计算技术研究了其DNA结合效能。结果表明，这些配合物作为沟槽结合剂，这一点由紫外吸收所证实。荧光研究，包括使用经典嵌入剂溴化乙锭作为荧光探针的置换实验，也确认了其为沟槽结合剂。粘度分析同样支持这两种配合物为强沟槽结合剂的推断。分子对接也揭示DNA是这些配合物的靶标，其中L(2)Cu精确结合于小沟区域，而L(2)VOCl结合于大沟区域。对L(2)Cu配合物进行的分子动力学模拟显示，该配合物在20 ns时间内与DNA发生相互作用。该配合物堆叠到寡核苷酸的氮碱基中，且键合特征在较长的模拟时间内得以固有保持。采用MTT实验对乳腺癌细胞系（MCF-7）进行了体外细胞毒性研究。观察到L(2)Cu和L(2)VOCl配合物具有潜在的细胞毒性活性，其IC(50)值分别显示71%和74%的抑制率。
